newsitem.title: USA: Netrix sees substantial Q1 operating loss.
newsitem.headline: Netrix sees substantial Q1 operating loss.

text.p: Netrix Corp on Thursday said it expected to post a substantial operating loss in its fiscal first quarter as a result of a shift to new products.

President and Chief Executive Lynn Chapman said sales of new products were expected to be slower than the decrease of the sales of its existing products. The company makes integrated network switching and management products.
"We expect that trend to be most significant in the first quarter and to reverse during the year," Chapman said in a statement.

"This will translate into a substantial operating loss in the first quarter, which will be combined with an aggressive effort to take a charge for any part of our operations that is not consistent with our marketing focus," he said.
In the previous first quarter, the company reported a net loss of $2.33 million, or $0.25 per share, on revenues of $11.19 million.
Trading in Netrix shares was halted by the Nasdaq late Thursday pending the announcement. The stock earlier fell 5/16 to 4-5/16, compared with its 52-week low of 3-3/4.
